source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第三节

textbook_summary: Biventricular findings cannot be represented by simply adding the findings of each ventricle.
Combined findings include an R-dominant V1 and right-axis deviation together with V5 R/S > 1 and increased R amplitude.

authored_choices.repolarization: Reference ST/T are retained; this does not imply that clinical biventricular hypertrophy necessarily has normal ST/T.
authored_choices.construction: Independent authored QRS targets reuse smooth components and inverse electrode construction. They are not a sum of the left/right ventricular examples or a calibrated tissue-vector model.

limitations: Only the third category of combined findings is represented; tissue mechanisms producing near-normal vector cancellation or masking of one ventricle are not modeled.
Not all biventricular hypertrophy morphologies are represented.
The axis is fixed; no continuous electrical-axis interface is provided.
Mechanical events and perfusion are unchanged; behavior on Windows hardware is not yet verified.
